</div> 
</div>

It&rsquo;s close to the harbor, the castle, restaurants and bars.</span></p><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-left"><span style="display: initial;">The room and bathrooms were clean, the bed comfortable.</span></p><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-left"><span style="display: initial;">The view from the roof top is amazing.  <section id="3d8a2e64" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="25988925" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="e68bee13" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="26bbbeaa" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="26d10159" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1727148193"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1727148193" style=""> <h2 class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="display: initial;">Frequently Asked</span><span style="font-weight: 600; display: initial;"><br/></span><span style="display: initial;">Questions</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="69bf7827" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" data-element-type="smartLayoutAccordion" data-layout-type="accordion" data-layout-first-open="false" data-layout-only-one-open="true"> <div id="c-99769d90" data-content-reference="99769d90" role="button" tabindex="0"> <h3 id="i-99769d90" class="accordion-title">What Amenities does the Kite House have?</h3> 
 <span id="icon-container-99769d90" class="icon-container"> <span id="icon-99769d90" class="icon"> <span id="icon-inner-99769d90"></span> 
</span> 
</span> 
</div> 
 <div class="accordion-item smart-child-wrapper" data-child-id="99769d90" id="w-99769d90"> <div id="99769d90" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" aria-hidden="true"> <div id="2988f340" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="a946f078" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1407523716"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1407523716" style=""> <h4 class="text-align-left t-size-16"><span style="display: initial;">The Kite House has the following communal areas:</span><span style="display: initial;" class="t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16"><br/></span></h4> 
 <h4 class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h4> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="a6547fa1" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1254421556"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1254421556" style=""> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li class="t-size-16 m-size-16 text-align-left size-16" style="color: var(--color_1);"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">Kitchen</span></li><li class="t-size-16 m-size-16 text-align-left size-16" style="color: var(--color_1);"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">Living Room</span></li><li class="t-size-16 m-size-16 text-align-left size-16" style="color: var(--color_1);"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">2 Bathrooms</span></li><li class="t-size-16 m-size-16 text-align-left size-16" style="color: var(--color_1);"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">And of course our wonderful Roof Terrace!<br/></span></li></ul> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="a440b62c" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="image" data-keep-proportion="true" data-external-id="1457432488"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1457432488" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1457432488"><img src="https://le-de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/opt/K-J-M+Beers+terrace+2-1920w.jpg" alt="" id="1758479117" class="" width="1600" height="1196" data-dm-image-path="https://de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/K-J-M+Beers+terrace+2.jpg" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="c-5bf3cb79" data-content-reference="5bf3cb79" role="button" tabindex="0"> <h3 id="i-5bf3cb79" class="accordion-title">How far is the Kite House from the beach?</h3> 
 <span id="icon-container-5bf3cb79" class="icon-container"> <span id="icon-5bf3cb79" class="icon"> <span id="icon-inner-5bf3cb79"></span> 
</span> 
</span> 
</div> 
 <div class="accordion-item smart-child-wrapper" data-child-id="5bf3cb79" id="w-5bf3cb79"> <div id="5bf3cb79" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" aria-hidden="true"> <div id="c9b52578" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="df034ed5" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1050951741"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1050951741" style=""><p class="t-size-16 m-size-16 size-16"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">We are located just 3-4 minute&acute;s walk from both Playa Chica and Playa de Los Lances</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="0a1b30a8" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="image" data-keep-proportion="true" data-external-id="1536887160"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1536887160" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1536887160"><img src="https://le-de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/opt/IMG_7810-1920w.jpg" alt="" id="1178981962" class="" width="1920" height="1440" data-dm-image-path="https://de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/IMG_7810.jpg" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="c-8844af78" data-content-reference="8844af78" role="button" tabindex="0"> <h3 id="i-8844af78" class="accordion-title">Are the Rooms Private or Shared?</h3> 
 <span id="icon-container-8844af78" class="icon-container"> <span id="icon-8844af78" class="icon"> <span id="icon-inner-8844af78"></span> 
</span> 
</span> 
</div> 
 <div class="accordion-item smart-child-wrapper" data-child-id="8844af78" id="w-8844af78"> <div id="8844af78" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" aria-hidden="true"> <div id="6092f17f" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="d7407cd2" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1173540923"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1173540923" style=""><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 size-16"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">All rooms are either Doubles or Singles. No sharing or dormitories here!</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="6641110f" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-keep-proportion="true" data-widget-type="image" data-external-id="1207363706"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1207363706" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1207363706"><img src="https://le-de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/opt/1000107378-1920w.jpg" alt="" id="1692619938" class="" width="1920" height="1440" data-dm-image-path="https://de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/1000107378.jpg" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="c-group_uul" data-content-reference="group_uul" role="button" tabindex="0"> <h3 id="i-group_uul" class="accordion-title">What are the check-in / check-out times?</h3> 
 <span id="icon-container-group_uul" class="icon-container"> <span id="icon-group_uul" class="icon"> <span id="icon-inner-group_uul"></span> 
</span> 
</span> 
</div> 
 <div class="accordion-item smart-child-wrapper" data-child-id="group_uul" id="w-group_uul"> <div id="group_uul" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group" aria-hidden="true"> <div id="widget_jcl" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1492105595"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1492105595" style=""><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 size-16"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: unset;">Check-in is from 14:00, and check-out is by 11:00 AM. If you want to arrive earlier and leave your bags - that&acute;s fine! Also if your room is ready before 14:00, we will let you know.</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div>
